events.title: HF Conference 2026 — April Fools
events.description: Omniscient ran an annual April Fools joke about a 'HF Conference 2026' in Vegas sponsored by 7, with ten members supposedly winning a free trip. Many had bags packed before realizing it was a prank.

events.title: Upload Images Testing
events.description: Omniscient's testing thread for the new encrypted image upload feature reported broad success — members are using the feature and the rollout is going smoothly.

events.title: Profile Redesign
events.description: Omniscient is exploring merging the general account profile and marketplace profile into a single combined screen, after years of confusion over the two separate profiles. Member ideas are being collected.

events.title: Guests View First Post Reverted
events.description: Omniscient reverted the guest-view-first-post feature after observing very high bot crawling activity that pushed view counts up unnaturally on many threads.

events.title: Member Contest Rules Consolidation
events.description: Mix published a single, simplified Member Contest Rules thread that consolidates roughly three previous pinned threads — making things easier for both contest hosts and entrants.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Shining Knight awarded to Redx_1188. King Decade awarded to Kisame, Yoadx, Dеvil, and Alideshell.

events.title: $500 BTC Contest - 5 Winners
events.description: Redx_1188 is hosting a $500 BTC contest with five $100 winners — open to L33t members with 10+ posts. Ends April 14. Earned the host the Shining Knight award.

events.title: Movie of the Week — Excalibur
events.description: JoshAllen submitted an upscaled 4K version of the classic Excalibur as Movie of the Week.
